storyline_updates.title: US presidential election 2012-11-06
storyline_updates.note: Calendar event 5 days out; pre-vote uncertainty, no surprise known.

reasoning: The only headline is a generic forecast piece with no new cause, so it is noise. Regime is normal (vol regime 2, 20d vol 0.67%), with no big days recently. Base rate is about 53% up. Small tilts: turn-of-month window (first trading day) and November strength add a little. Offsetting this, the presidential election is 5 days away and pre-vote choppiness is likely, with a weak recent 5d trend. Net confidence is just at the 0.55 threshold, so take a modest long.
would_change_my_mind: A large negative surprise before the open (credit, geopolitical or Fed shock) or a spike in volatility would send me flat.
